targetReport.title: Agreement on the New Development Bank (Fortaleza, 15 July 2014) and annexed Articles of Agreement
targetReport.publisher: Governments of the Federative Republic of Brazil, the Russian Federation, the Republic of India, the People's Republic of China and the Republic of South Africa
targetReport.description: Foundational treaty establishing the New Development Bank (NDB). Signed in Fortaleza on 15 July 2014 by the five founding BRICS members. Entered into force 3 July 2015 after all five deposited instruments of acceptance/ratification. Russia ratified by Federal Law No. 29-FZ of 8 March 2015. Creates the Bank, sets purpose (mobilise resources for infrastructure and sustainable development in BRICS and other EMDCs), capital structure (initial authorised USD 100 bn, subscribed USD 50 bn), governance, and membership rules. Continuously cited as the legal basis in every subsequent NDB Annual Report, strategy document, and project approval.
